serena.notes: Portable symbol/code-intelligence MCP. Install with `uv tool install -p 3.13 serena-agent`, then run `serena init`.

context7.notes: Version-aware library documentation. API key may improve rate limits.

deepwiki.notes: Remote service for public repositories; do not send private code without authorization.

repomix.notes: Pack local/remote repositories into bounded AI-friendly context.

grepai.notes: Requires initialized/built grepai index and embedding provider.

codegraph.notes: Install CodeGraph engine first. Prefer core/graph profiles to reduce tool-schema cost.

code-review-graph.notes: Use `code-review-graph install --platform claude-code` or `--platform codex`; upstream installer writes host-specific MCP/hooks safely.

mem0.notes: Hosted Mem0 MCP example; keep secrets in environment variables.

graphiti.notes: Run Graphiti MCP separately (commonly Docker + graph backend) before enabling.

cognee.notes: Install/configure Cognee separately; its UI can launch an MCP server in Docker. Prefer its official integration when available.

letta.notes: Letta is an agent harness/SDK, not a drop-in memory MCP for this plugin. Integrate only when intentionally running a persistent Letta agent.

jetbrains.notes: Enable/configure the built-in JetBrains MCP server from the IDE; do not spawn it from this plugin.

zoekt.notes: Use zoekt CLI/index services; no bundled MCP is assumed.
